instruction: In SolveSpace, import seed_ss_gui_01_baseplate.dxf from /home/user/Desktop with File > Import, then continue editing that imported drawing rather than starting from an empty document. Do not use File > Open or launch the DXF as a native SolveSpace file. Keep the baseplate as the source geometry, resize the outer rectangle to width 120 and height 80, update the two circular holes to diameter 10 with centers at (25,40) and (95,40), and update the horizontal centerline so it runs through the middle of the baseplate with endpoints at (0,40) and (120,40). Construction or guide geometry from the seed may be changed or removed unless it is explicitly required above. When the geometry is complete, align the view to the active workplane if needed, then use File > Export 2d View, choose the DXF file type, and save the result as /home/user/Desktop/final_ss_gui_01.dxf. Do not use File > Save As for this final DXF export.
